title: Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.05265v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction l

translated_title: Loopy：面向循环语言模型的低比特量化框架
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型通过重复执行一个共享的循环核心，提供了一种参数高效的方式来扩展迭代式的测试时计算。训练后量化（PTQ）可以降低循环语言模型的内存占用和推理成本，但共享核心量化所引入的误差会影响后续的核心。在各类PTQ方法中，通道缩放和正交旋转能够在保持浮点计算的同时，生成具有不同量化质量的表示。我们发现，量化配置候选的排序会随循环深度而变化，这促使我们需要在目标部署深度上进行配置选择。然而，在该深度上使用完整校准集评估每一个候选的成本非常高。因此，我们提出了Loopy，一个通过感知循环深度的目标函数来形式化共享核心量化问题的PTQ框架，根据最终预测结果来选择共享的低比特表示
tldr: 提出了Loopy量化框架，通过感知循环深度的目标函数为循环语言模型的共享核心选择最优低比特量化配置，解决了量化误差随循环迭代累积传播且配置排序随深度变化的问题。
en_tdlr: Loopy is a post-training quantization framework that selects optimal low-bit configurations for looped language models' shared cores via a recurrent-depth-aware objective, addressing how quantization errors propagate across recurrent iterations and configuration rankings shift with depth.
